blockers.title: ATTACH weighted cluster-pick has no semantic bias pin — a uniform-pick regression passes the entire unit suite
blockers.evidence: map_test phase 2: cat.balance.growth_districts.seed_weights[int(District_Kind.Suburb)] = 4 (= city's 4 — parity); testing.expectf(t, b_spawns > 0, ...). Spec pin 3: 'two estates in districts of different weights — the rich district's estate extends more (fixture with both clusters eligible)'. No test asserts unequal-weight attach behavior.
blockers.detail: The zoom-band model's ATTACH side (a headline behavior of this job) is pinned only via its exclusion predicate. The positive control runs at weight PARITY (suburb 4 = city 4), so it proves exclusion-is-the-weight, not bias. A regression of weighted_pick back to uniform passes all 8 new unit pins; only a whole-golden re-bless diff would catch it — exactly the failure mode mutation-verified pins exist to prevent. Spec §3 pin 3 clause 1 ('the rich district's estate extends more') is undelivered and un-acknowledged in the PR body.
blockers.recommended_fix: Add one fixture test: two eligible estates, unequal seed-district weights (e.g. city 4 vs suburb 1), assert the rich district's estate extends more over N deterministic windows; mutation-verify by flipping weighted_pick to rng_range.

warnings.title: ATTACH member tile's own district is never cap-checked — cross-boundary estates can exceed the claimed hard bound
warnings.evidence: if board != nil { d := map_district_assign(board, t.node_pos[i]) (the cluster's FIRST member = seed); if growth_district_live_count(board, t, d) >= growth_district_cap(board, cat, d) { continue } — while the ring draw places members on any pool tile (global ring, streets rule).
warnings.detail: Estates straddle Voronoi boundaries by design (PR body + audit); a straddling estate's members count toward their OWN districts' live counts but only the seed district's cap gates extension. A capped district can still gain members from a foreign estate — contradicting the 'hard bound / never more houses than the blessed fabric' claim (PR body + balance.json _comment). Bounded in practice (5-member estates, min_sep packing) but reachable at the user's 667 iteration target.
warnings.recommended_fix: Either cap-check the drawn ring tile's own district before placement (reject + redraw), or scope the claim in the PR body/_comment to 'seed-side bound' and document the straddle leak as accepted.

warnings.title: Spec pin 4 clause 'demolished terminals free the budget' is claimed but untestable — terminals are never demolishable (E2)
warnings.location: core/topology.odin:274 (is_terminal -> .Terminal_Demolish) vs spec §3 pin 4 + PR body
warnings.evidence: validate_demolish_node: if is_terminal(t, slot) { return .Terminal_Demolish } // E2 — terminals cannot be demolished; growth_district_live_count derives from live terminals by construction.
warnings.detail: The behavior holds inherently (derived counts), but the spec pin promises a test no mechanism can trigger, and the PR body lists it as delivered behavior. Should be acknowledged as vacuous-by-design rather than claimed as verified.
warnings.recommended_fix: Acknowledge in spec/PR that the clause is inherent to derive-don't-record (untestable under E2); or add a fixture-level unit test on growth_district_live_count with a manually-deactivated terminal.

warnings.title: growth_district_live_count's Terminal-only filter is unpinned — a routers-count-too mutation passes the suite
warnings.evidence: growth_district_live_count counts nodes where node_kind == .Terminal only; no test asserts routers are excluded from district budgets.
warnings.detail: P2 gap: the district cap's denominator semantics (routers must not consume terminal budget) rest on an unpinned predicate.
warnings.recommended_fix: One unit pin: a district with routers-only nodes must read live=0 (cap unaffected).

warnings.title: Loader pass-3 district partition is never asserted — fixtures mirror the derivation instead of testing it
warnings.evidence: district_tiles built at map.odin:422 (make + append per tile); every unit test builds its own lists by hand; no test loads a board fixture and asserts pass 3's output.
warnings.detail: P2 gap: deleting the loader's pass 3 (empty district_tiles -> all board growth dead) fails no unit test; only integration goldens would catch it.
warnings.recommended_fix: Add a loader-level test: load a minimal board json fixture, assert district_tiles partitions spawn_candidates exactly.
